_about: The C++ toolchain the installer uses under Wine/Proton (Linux), where Microsoft's C++ Build Tools do not install. toolchain_fetch.py downloads each part from where it is published and checks the archive's SHA-256 before anything is taken out of it. A part whose sha256 is null would never be downloaded; all four are pinned (official GitHub release assets, hashed 2026-11-24). MA2_TOOLCHAIN_SOURCE (a folder holding the same archives, or the parts already laid out) is used instead of the internet when set.

xwin._about: xwin downloads the Microsoft C runtime and Windows SDK from Microsoft's own Visual Studio package feed (each package checked against the SHA-256 in Microsoft's manifest) and lays them out for clang. It runs only after the player accepted Microsoft's licence terms. splat --disable-symlinks: no case-variant symlinks (Windows and Wine look names up without case).

d3dcompiler._about: Owner decision 11-24: NO Microsoft DLL in the kit, ever. Under Wine/Proton from wine_host.WINE_BUILTIN_D3DCOMPILER_MIN on, Wine's own d3dcompiler is used. On older Wine the installer tells the player to put d3dcompiler_47.dll in the game folder themselves and checks for it afterwards (install.py wine_d3dcompiler). Never anything on Windows.
